representations.name: output-projected legal-switch hypergraph
representations.new_information: Vertices are demands, named missing-B outputs and indispensable resources; certificate multiplicity is quotiented out.
representations.first_test: Re-encode the n=15 witness and verify matching rank zero despite 736 paths.

representations.name: two-new-vertex exact threshold extension
representations.new_information: Allows two distinct new B outputs while preserving the exact edge threshold.
representations.first_test: Enumerate bounded n=16 extensions of the locked n=14 core with an explicit edge budget.

representations.name: non-rainbow C7 obstruction cores
representations.new_information: Records the minimal old/new edge sets responsible for switch illegality.
representations.first_test: Extract obstruction cores for all 15 failed n=15 switch subsets.

representations.name: exact SAT switch ledger
representations.new_information: Separates graph choice, colour equality, singleton legality and joint legality as exact clauses.
representations.first_test: Solve the smallest two-output two-switch extension without floating search.

representations.name: alternating output exchange digraph
representations.new_information: Retains the terminal output of every exchange and rejects paths returning to the old K(e).
representations.first_test: Replay every natural b-to-w switch in the n=15 graph.

representations.name: resource-incidence codegree tensor
representations.new_information: Measures output, owner, internal-edge and C7-witness overlaps separately.
representations.first_test: Compute pair codegrees for any first legal two-output witness.

representations.name: deficient-cut submodular profile
representations.new_information: Keeps the full function T maps to |N(T)|-|T| instead of average degree.
representations.first_test: Evaluate all cuts of the four-demand locked circuit after candidate augmentation.

representations.name: switch-obstruction hitting set
representations.new_information: Identifies the minimum graph or colour changes needed to destroy every bad C7 while retaining threshold density.
representations.first_test: Hit all n=15 natural-switch obstruction cores under one added-vertex edge swap.

representations.name: stability-preserving output reservoir
representations.new_information: Tracks whether exceptional vertices carry every rank-increasing output before they are discarded.
representations.first_test: Partition outputs by endpoint type in exact threshold extensions.

representations.name: local-output to every-cut composition
representations.new_information: States the precise expansion and codegree hypotheses needed for deterministic cleanup.
representations.first_test: Test whether two-output local rank changes any non-singleton locked cut.
